checklist_requirement: Identify the report as a systematic review.
Use the PRISMA 2020 for Abstracts checklist.
Describe the rationale in the context of existing knowledge.
Provide an explicit statement of the objective(s) or question(s).
Specify inclusion/exclusion criteria and how studies were grouped for syntheses.
Specify all databases, registers, websites, organisations, reference lists, and other sources searched or consulted, and the date each source was last searched or consulted.
Present full strategies for all databases, registers, and websites, including filters and limits.
Describe screening, eligibility, reviewer numbers, independence, and automation tools.
Describe data collection, reviewer numbers, independence, and author-contact processes.
List and define all outcomes sought and assumptions used for missing/unclear results.
List other variables sought and assumptions for missing/unclear information.
Specify tools, reviewer process, independence, and automation.
Specify effect measures used for each outcome.
Describe how studies were judged eligible for each synthesis.
Describe methods required to prepare data for presentation or synthesis.
Describe methods used to tabulate or visually display results.
Describe synthesis models, rationale, heterogeneity methods, and software.
Describe methods to investigate possible causes of heterogeneity.
Describe sensitivity analyses used to assess robustness.
Describe methods to assess risk of bias due to missing results.
Describe methods to assess certainty/confidence in the body of evidence.
Describe the results of the search and selection process, from records identified through studies included, ideally using a flow diagram.
Cite studies that might appear to meet the inclusion criteria but were excluded, and explain why.
Cite each included study and present its characteristics.
Present risk-of-bias assessments for each included study.
Present outcome data and effect estimates with precision for each study.
Summarise characteristics and risk of bias among studies contributing to each synthesis.
Present results of all statistical syntheses, precision, and heterogeneity.
Present results of all investigations of possible causes of heterogeneity.
Present results of all sensitivity analyses.
Present assessments of risk of bias due to missing results.
Present certainty/confidence assessments for each outcome.
Provide a general interpretation in the context of other evidence.
Discuss limitations of the evidence included in the review.
Discuss limitations of the review processes used.
Discuss implications for practice, policy, and future research.
Provide registration information or state that the review was not registered.
Indicate where the protocol can be accessed or state that no protocol was prepared.
Describe and explain amendments to information provided at registration/protocol.
Describe financial/non-financial support and funder role.
Declare competing interests of review authors.
Report availability and location of forms, extracted data, analysis data, code, and other materials.
